doc.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24

title: Bunk Johnson's age when he died
summary: Allen asks how old Bunk Johnson was; Mr. Senegal estimates close to 70 and calls him a fine man.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: How old was Bunk Johnson, did you say?

Well, Bunk Johnson was, let me see, when Bunk Johnson died, I think Bunk Johnson was about 60 to 80 years old, close to 70, at that time. So he's older than you, huh? He's older than I, yeah. He's about four or five years old. Bunk Johnson was a fine, good age, fine man. She wrote there.
